name: Tooga's Quest
objectiveText: Show Tooga the way back to his wife, Torta .   Lead Tooga to Torta  ( 1 )

comments.body:
[b]Tooga[/b] is found at ([b]29,60[/b]) , in the northern parts of the Thistleshrub Valley. You might have to wait for him to respawn.
He doesn't roam, almost stays at the same spot.

[b]Torta[/b] is at ([b]66,25[/b]) , just south of the Steemwheedle Port in the north east. She's always there so no waiting there.

Mobs neer Tooga are lvl48-49 elementals.
Mobs go down from lvl45 to lvl40ish in the north (scorpids/wolves/basilisks).

Also...
[b]Tooga follows YOU[/b], you don't have to follow him. He walks at around 110% speed, so running with a steed might get him lost.
He attracts almost no agro and if you take care where you walk you can walk all the way without fighting a single mob.

If you arrive, Tooga's gonna have some words with his wife:
---
[i]Tooga:[/i] Torta, my love! I have returned at long last.
[i]Torta:[/i] You have any idea how long I've been waiting here? And where's dinner? All that time gone and nothing to show for it?
[i]Tooga:[/i] My dearest Torta, I have been gone for so long. Finally we are reunited. At long last our love van blossom again.
[i]Torta:[/i] Enough with the rambling. I am starving! Now, get your dusty shell into that ocean and bring momma some grub.
[i]Tooga:[/i] Yes, torta. Whatever your heart desires...
---
replies: poor tooga

comments.body:
I have done this quest many a time with different characters, but always find him in different locs, either by zepplin or next to the Thistleshrubs.. today for the first time I actually watched him spawn.. he spawned AT the zepplin, then started his walk toward the Thistleshrubs.. hope this helps if you need to find him. 

Also, when I escort him, I have found the easiest way is to mount up (so you can see mobs better and pick around them) and run about 6 paces, then let him catch up, walking slowly, rinse repeat.. it's easy to avoid mobs and quick this way.. just be sure to keep him targeted, because he sometimes draws aggros, and you don't want to lose the guy.
Just a word of advice..if you pull aggro, STOP AND KILL IT. Tooga will keep attacking it until it's dead, so if you try and outrun the aggro, Tooga will fall behind.
Poor Tooga, Torta is a real $%^&*!

Easy escort -- true escort quest where you only engage mobs you want to engage.  So you can just grind in a straight line, or you can avoid.  Just remember he has a level 45 aggro range.    Your biggest danger will be other players

He does NOT go any faster if you mount. If you attack a mob first and he has to run to catch up and help you fight, he resets back to where he aggro'd after you kill mob  so just keep an eye on him.  This means do NOT try to kite a mob towards the destination, otherwise it's even further he will run back and you may get out of range.

**If doing this as a group, you can individually fail this by getting out of proximity of him.  We had a guy who was like "i'll run ahead and clear a path" and he failed it**

He should divorce his turtly wife. Anyway. You should do this quest after finishing "The Thirsty Goblin" and "Thistleshrub Valley" Both are done in the immediate surroundings of the turtle, and the turn in is near his wife. Three quests in one trip! Go me!

Why can these particular two turtles talk, but not any of the others?

You can try to write it off to "it's all made up anyway", in which case I am a level 75 black dragon with 3,700,000 HP and you're toast.  Why not?  It's all made up anyway...

Seriously, games like this only work if there is a certain degree of consistancy.  You don't expect the same mob in the same zone to range from level 5 to level 75.  You don't expect Gadgetzan Bruisers to be neutral today, friendly tomorrow and hostile the day after with no action on your part.  You could never d

This is a magical world after all.  Personally Id like to have hippogriffs (or equivilent) tell jokes on the longer flights, or perhaps chat away.

'Hay <race>, Why did the Hippogriff fly over the road?  Cause Hioopgriffs, dont have to walk.  Hahaha, I crack myself up'

 Or it could be just that they DO want to talk about their family problems - But arn't going to talk about them with the likes of you :p  you are the enemy of most of them afterall. :)

I soloed this as a 47 Druid. I found him at the end of Thistleshrub valley when I was doing the other Thistleshrub quests (laden dew gland and the Thistleshrub exploration one).

I just cleared out the mobs at the entrance to the valley, then started the quest. One shrub aggroed us on the way out, but like everyone says, when you get into the desert, he follows you (don't ride a mount or get too far ahead of him). Since he follows you, and there is plenty of time on the time, you can avoid aggroing the mobs in the desert.

Two comments on location and respawn for Tooga:

1. He can spawn anywhere near the abandoned camp in the southwest corner of the zone, south and east of Thistleshrub Valley.  I've seen him both east and west of the shelter thing in the abandoned (burned out?) camp there.  I think he spawns in one of a few spots and wanders in a small path around his spawn point, so if you miss him in one spot, loop around and check the other nearby areas.  He doesn't wander far.

2. I was about to grab the quest when two Alliance yoyos grabbed him and ran off with him, so I logged to an alt and kept checking b
